note: The SFV News crawl on sfv.fm. Items drop off after their 'until' (Pacific, 24-hour). kind: news, opening, event, tidbit. Checked against each src.

items.text: Metro broke ground Oct. 19 on the East San Fernando Valley light rail line linking Van Nuys and Pacoima.
Hollywood Burbank Airport's new $1.3 billion, 14-gate terminal opened to passengers Oct. 13.
L.A. County vote centers are open 10 a.m.-7 p.m. daily, with 523 more opening Oct. 31; Election Day is Nov. 3.
Burbank voters will decide Measure C, a hotel tax increase, and Measures CC and CD on district council elections.
Tim Gaspar and Barri Worth Girvan meet in the Nov. 3 runoff for the West Valley's open Council District 3 seat.
Glendale City Council approved $2.8 million for Beeline bus service changes set to begin in summer 2027.
Charles Maclay Middle School in Pacoima has officially been renamed Glenoaks Academy.
Glendale Community College opened a virtual reality learning center in its Camino Real building.
Toluca Lake: Bar Harry, a Blondie-inspired cocktail bar on Riverside Drive.
Downtown Glendale: Bratnbier, a sausage and beer spot on West California Avenue.
Opening Nov. 7: 'Wonder Lanes,' mid-century bowling signs at Glendale's Museum of Neon Art.
Fright Fest runs Oct. 29-31 at Six Flags Magic Mountain in Valencia, nightly from 6:30 p.m.
Majo Aguilar plays The Soraya in Northridge on Thursday, Oct. 29, at 8 p.m.; the show is sold out.
Burbank Town Center hosts Halloween trick-or-treating on Saturday, Oct. 31, from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m.
Australian troupe Circa brings 'Duck Pond' to The Soraya in Northridge on Sunday, Nov. 1, at 3 p.m.
The San Fernando Valley will have its first-ever themed float in the 2027 Rose Parade on New Year's Day.
The Valley Relics Museum at Van Nuys Airport now opens Tuesdays too, 10 to 2.
